aegis.sql:
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(o.OrderTotal, 0)) AS value
FROM `Order` o
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0

results.prompt: What is net revenue after refunds?

aegis.sql:
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(o.OrderTotal, 0) - COALESCE(o.RefundedAmount, 0)) AS value
FROM `Order` o
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m') AS label, SUM(COALESCE(o.OrderTotal, 0)) AS value
FROM `Order` o
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY label asc
LIMIT 100

results.prompt: Break down revenue by order status

aegis.sql:
SELECT CASE o.OrderStatusId WHEN 10 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 20 THEN 'Processing' WHEN 30 THEN 'Complete' WHEN 40 THEN 'Cancelled' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS label, SUM(COALESCE(o.OrderTotal, 0)) AS value
FROM `Order` o
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY CASE o.OrderStatusId WHEN 10 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 20 THEN 'Processing' WHEN 30 THEN 'Complete' WHEN 40 THEN 'Cancelled' ELSE 'Unknown' END
ORDER BY value desc
LIMIT 100

results.prompt: How many orders are in each payment status?

aegis.sql:
SELECT CASE o.PaymentStatusId WHEN 10 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 20 THEN 'Authorized' WHEN 30 THEN 'Paid' WHEN 35 THEN 'PartiallyRefunded' WHEN 40 THEN 'Refunded' WHEN 50 THEN 'Voided' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT o.Id) AS value
FROM `Order` o
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY CASE o.PaymentStatusId WHEN 10 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 20 THEN 'Authorized' WHEN 30 THEN 'Paid' WHEN 35 THEN 'PartiallyRefunded' WHEN 40 THEN 'Refunded' WHEN 50 THEN 'Voided' ELSE 'Unknown' END
ORDER BY value desc
LIMIT 100

results.prompt: Average order value by billing country

aegis.sql:
SELECT co.Name AS label, AVG(COALESCE(o.OrderTotal, 0)) AS value
FROM `Order` o
INNER JOIN `Address` addr ON o.BillingAddressId = addr.Id
INNER JOIN `Country` co ON addr.CountryId = co.Id
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY co.Name
ORDER BY value desc
LIMIT 100

SELECT o.ShippingMethod AS label, SUM(o.OrderShippingExclTax) AS value
FROM `Order` o
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY o.ShippingMethod
ORDER BY value desc
LIMIT 100

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m') AS label, SUM(o.RefundedAmount) AS value
FROM `Order` o
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY label asc
LIMIT 100

SELECT CASE o.PaymentStatusId WHEN 10 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 20 THEN 'Authorized' WHEN 30 THEN 'Paid' WHEN 35 THEN 'PartiallyRefunded' WHEN 40 THEN 'Refunded' WHEN 50 THEN 'Voided' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS label, SUM(COALESCE(o.RefundedAmount,0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(o.OrderTotal,0)), 0) AS value
FROM `Order` o
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY CASE o.PaymentStatusId WHEN 10 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 20 THEN 'Authorized' WHEN 30 THEN 'Paid' WHEN 35 THEN 'PartiallyRefunded' WHEN 40 THEN 'Refunded' WHEN 50 THEN 'Voided' ELSE 'Unknown' END
ORDER BY value desc
LIMIT 100

SELECT CASE o.OrderStatusId WHEN 10 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 20 THEN 'Processing' WHEN 30 THEN 'Complete' WHEN 40 THEN 'Cancelled' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS label, SUM(o.OrderDiscount) AS value
FROM `Order` o
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY CASE o.OrderStatusId WHEN 10 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 20 THEN 'Processing' WHEN 30 THEN 'Complete' WHEN 40 THEN 'Cancelled' ELSE 'Unknown' END
ORDER BY value desc
LIMIT 100

SELECT c.Name AS label, SUM(oi.PriceExclTax) AS value
FROM `Order` o
LEFT JOIN `OrderItem` oi ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
LEFT JOIN `Product` p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
LEFT JOIN `Product_Category_Mapping` pcm ON p.Id = pcm.ProductId
LEFT JOIN `Category` c ON pcm.CategoryId = c.Id
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0
  AND p.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.Name
ORDER BY value desc
LIMIT 100

SELECT mf.Name AS label, SUM(COALESCE(oi.Quantity, 0)) AS value
FROM `Order` o
LEFT JOIN `OrderItem` oi ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
LEFT JOIN `Product` p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
INNER JOIN `Product_Manufacturer_Mapping` pmm ON p.Id = pmm.ProductId
INNER JOIN `Manufacturer` mf ON pmm.ManufacturerId = mf.Id
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0
  AND p.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY mf.Name
ORDER BY value desc
LIMIT 100

SELECT p.Name AS label, SUM(COALESCE(oi.PriceExclTax, 0) - COALESCE(oi.OriginalProductCost, 0) * COALESCE(oi.Quantity, 0)) AS value
FROM `Order` o
LEFT JOIN `OrderItem` oi ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
LEFT JOIN `Product` p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0
  AND p.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY p.Name
ORDER BY value desc
LIMIT 10

SELECT cu.Email AS label, SUM(COALESCE(o.OrderTotal, 0)) AS value
FROM `Order` o
INNER JOIN `Customer` cu ON o.CustomerId = cu.Id
WHERE 1=1
  AND cu.Deleted = 0
  AND o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY cu.Id
ORDER BY value desc
LIMIT 10

SELECT p.Name AS `Product Name`, p.StockQuantity AS `Stock Qty`, p.ApprovedTotalReviews AS `Reviews`
FROM `Product` p
WHERE 1=1
  AND (p.ManageInventoryMethodId = 1 AND (CASE WHEN p.UseMultipleWarehouses = 1 THEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pwi.StockQuantity - pwi.ReservedQuantity), 0) FROM `ProductWarehouseInventory` pwi WHERE pwi.ProductId = p.Id) ELSE p.StockQuantity END) <= p.MinStockQuantity AND p.Deleted = 0 AND p.ProductTypeId <> 10)
  AND p.Deleted = 0
LIMIT 100

results.prompt: How many customers registered this year?

aegis.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cu.Id) AS value
FROM `Customer` cu
WHERE 1=1
  AND (cu.CreatedOnUtc >= MAKEDATE(YEAR(UTC_TIMESTAMP()), 1) AND cu.CreatedOnUtc < MAKEDATE(YEAR(UTC_TIMESTAMP()), 1) + INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
  AND cu.Deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cu.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m') AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT cu.Id) AS value
FROM `Customer` cu
WHERE 1=1
  AND cu.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(cu.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY label asc
LIMIT 100

SELECT st.Name AS label, SUM(COALESCE(o.OrderTotal, 0)) AS value
FROM `Order` o
INNER JOIN `Store` st ON o.StoreId = st.Id
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY st.Name
ORDER BY value desc
LIMIT 100

SELECT o.CustomOrderNumber AS `Order Number`, COALESCE(o.OrderTotal, 0) AS `Total Revenue`, o.CreatedOnUtc AS `Order Date`
FROM `Order` o
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.Deleted = 0
ORDER BY o.CreatedOnUtc DESC, o.Id DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT sterm.Keyword AS label, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM `SearchTerm` sterm
WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY sterm.Keyword
ORDER BY value desc
LIMIT 5
